title: Models and simulations of structural DNA nanotechnology reveal fundamental principles of self-assembly
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,2344-2368
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01095G, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Alexander Cumberworth, Aleks Reinhardt
We explore how simulations and modelling help us to learn about the fundamental principles of DNA self-assembly; we highlight key concepts such as cooperativity and nucleation and show how they can be harnessed to improve the self-assembly process.
